text:
maria-ops: FYI starting a coordinated base-image flatten + rebuild next week to remove legacy SUID binaries, refresh OpenSSL -> 3.x, and apply minimal runtime footprint. Need RBAC/KMS/audit alignment before we sign and roll. Tentative window: Tue 09:00 UTC.
aj: ack. can you drop the checklist here? i want to verify any IAM grants needed for cosign KMS signing.
maria-ops: short checklist: 1) build reproducible image artifacts 2) run vuln scan + triage 3) sign artifacts with cosign using HSM-backed KMS key 4) push to private registry with immutability tags 5) canary deploy to staging 6) enable node-level attestation (optional) 7) monitor audit logs for denied pulls.
lucas: for step 3, which KMS key? we should avoid granting broad kms:Decrypt permissions to build CI runners. prefer a signing role with iam:sign only.
maria-ops: agreed. proposed principal: build-signer@redwood-ci. Grant "cloudkms.cryptoSign" and restrict to key ring:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image-sign/cryptoKeys/cosign-sign. No Decrypt.
nora: is there an example IAM policy? paste it pls — ops will need to add to terraform.
maria-ops: paste: ```json
{
  "role": "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier",
  "members": ["serviceAccount:build-signer@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com"],
  "condition": null
}
```
(We'll narrow condition by project + action in TF)
aj: will cosign + KMS flow work with our ephemeral CI runners? iirc cosign needs a signer plugin. we run cosign with the KMS plugin like: `COSIGN_KMS_PROVIDER=gcp cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/.../cryptoKeys/... image:tag`
lucas: yep. also remind that cosign needs to be pinned to our approved binary in the CI image to avoid supply chain tampering.
sec-bot: security-issue: CVE-2024-5678 found in base alpine layer (libcrypto). status: triage required. severity: HIGH.
maria-ops: noted — we'll bump opensec upgrade to patch the libcrypto callout. nora, can you own triage and confirm there are no runtime exposures in our container shim?
nora: on it. I'll run the runtime exploit checklists against the current image and post results by EOD.
oncall-rotation: if triage finds exploitability in prod, immediate steps: 1) block image pulls by tag in registry 2) emergency rotation of signing key (rotate to next key version) 3) rollback to last-known-good image 4) open incident and run full forensics.
aj: about audit logging — we need to ensure KMS key use gets logged in audit logs and that registry download auth events are forwarded to our central ledger. are we sending cloudkms.audit logs to SIEM?
maria-ops: yes, cloudkms.admin/audit logs go to stackloom SIEM topic. but signer-verifier events appear under cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.use. we should add a filter to surface cosign sign attempts and failures.
lucas: also add registry:pull and registry:manifest access to the alert rules; set rate-based suppression so staging churn doesn't spam oncall.
nora: vuln triage update: quick scan shows libcrypto call vector requires a specific cipher usage — low chance in our runtime path, but we'll still upgrade to be safe. ticket created: https://tracker.redwood/s/ISSUE-4821
maria-ops: deployment plan: build in CI with new image, run canary in staging for 4 hours, run chaos-lite (SIGTERM killer) to verify fallback, then 50% in internal, then 100% public. rollback if error rate > 1% or authentication errors > 0.1%.
oncall-rotation: please add runbook snippet to incident channel: how to quickly revoke signer IAM and rotate to v2 key. We need explicit terraform steps.
aj: terraform note: we'll add a new key version and update cosign config in CI via secret manager. avoid inline plaintext. also ensure IAM grants are applied with least-privilege and terraform plan is reviewed by sec team.
maria-ops: owners: image build + sign: aj; KMS + IAM policy: lucas; vuln triage: nora; oncall/monitoring config: oncall-rotation. Deliverables due Mon 17:00 UTC.
lucas: i'll prepare the IAM TF snippet and a minimal policy doc. ping me if you need early review.
maria-ops: thanks — also note we will produce an audit checklist for the post-rollout review: verify cosign verifications, audit event counts, and SBOM attachments present.
aj: one more Q: do we want to add a pre-sign manual approval step in CI for prod-promote? i prefer yes for one week while trust stabilizes.
maria-ops: yes — require a human approval gate for prod for the first week. we'll revisit after metric stability.
sec-bot: reminder: add attestation predicate to cosign signatures with build metadata (git sha, builder image digest).
nora: final: I'll post triage findings shortly and link the scanner output. if anything high-risk, i'll escalate to incident.
maria-ops: perfect. thanks team — will drop the formal playbook + terraform PR by tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
